description:
Check whether a person qualifies for citizenship by descent.

    Give the user's direct ancestral line, one entry per generation, starting
    with relation='self'. Every generation between the user and the ancestor
    must be present even if little is known about them, because descent passes
    generation by generation and a gap changes the answer.

    Ask for exact dates where you can. Year-only input is accepted but the
    result will carry a caveat, and for Ireland a registration and a birth in
    the same year cannot be resolved at all.

    Args:
        country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase. Currently 'ie' or 'ca'.
        line: The direct line, from the user upward.
        as_of: Evaluation date. Defaults to today. Rules with commencement
            dates (Canada's Bill C-3) depend on it.

LineMember.description: One person on the user's direct ancestral line.

birth_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of birth, e.g. 'IE', 'CA', 'US'. For Northern Ireland use 'IE' — Irish nationality law counts all 32 counties.
birth_country.title: Birth Country

birth_date.description: Exact date of birth if known. Beats birth_year.
birth_date.title: Birth Date

birth_place_label.description: Free-text place of birth, e.g. 'Cork, Ireland'.
birth_place_label.title: Birth Place Label

birth_year.description: Year of birth if the exact date is unknown.
birth_year.title: Birth Year

citizenship_registered_country.description: Country of a formal citizenship registration, e.g. 'IE' for an Irish Foreign Births Register entry. This is what carries a claim down a generation.
citizenship_registered_country.title: Citizenship Registered Country

days_in_country.description: Days of physical presence in the ancestral country. Canada's Bill C-3 substantial-connection test needs this; other pathways ignore it.
days_in_country.title: Days In Country

naturalized_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where this person naturalized, if any.
naturalized_country.title: Naturalized Country

relation.description: Where this person sits on your direct line. Use exactly one 'self'.
relation.title: Relation
